headline: Building use requests at Hamden High School and Shepherd Glen School, plus Title IX policy revisions.
summary: Four requests from a swim club and a PTA cover use of school pools, cafeterias, gyms, and locker rooms. Ten consent items include policy repeals, two April 2027 school trips, book discards, and budget transfers.
items: Recognition of five Hamden Heroes from April

Revision to Policy 5145.5, Title IX Sex Discrimination and Harassment

HAMDEN BOARD OF EDUCATION 
ANNOUNCEMENT OF BOARD OF EDUCATION MEETING AGENDA 
TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 10, 2026 
 
Public Session:  7:00 PM  
Location- Boardroom at 60 Putnam Ave. Hamden, CT 
 
To join the meeting virtually, please click the link below to join the webinar: 
https://hamden.zoom.us/j/81400831407?pwd=BTiad9aVtGvubyo2R8VWa2MifTaL67.1  
Passcode:916610 
 
Telephone: +1 312 626 6799, +1 646 558 8656, +1 646 931 3860, +1 301 715 8592, +1 305 224 1968 
Webinar ID: 814 0083 1407 
Passcode: 916610 
International numbers available: https://hamden.zoom.us/u/kkmewJsAs 
 
For those who wish to make Public Comments:  
Time will be allotted for public comments on agenda items at the beginning of the meeting. We ask that public 
comments be limited to no more than 3 minutes in length. You may also submit your comment in writing. Public 
comments should be sent to PublicInput@hamden.org, with the message's subject stating the meeting's name and 
date (for example, “May 12 Operations Committee Meeting”). Public comments will be accepted up to 1 p.m. the 
day of the meeting.  
Please note the following: 
• The name and Hamden address of the person submitting public comment must be included in the message.  
• Remarks should be brief and concise, with a maximum length of three minutes (about 450 characters).  
• Comments should start with a 2-3 sentence summary. The summary will be read instead of the entire 
message if there is a large number of comments and reading each of them in their entirety would extend 
beyond the time allotted for public comment.
